newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary overnight rates fall to 20.375 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary overnight rates fall to 20.375 percent.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates fell in the first day of the new two-week reserve period in a sluggish market, traders said on Monday.
Rates moved between 20.5 and 21.00 percent and ended at 20.375, compared to Friday's close of 21.00 percent.
"The banks are a little cautious following last week's decision by the central bank at the long end," said Gabor Liener of Unicbank. "I expect levels to stay at around 20-3/8 for the next few days."
The National Bank of Hungary on Friday cut its six-month deposit interest rate to 20.50 percent from 21.00 percent and the 12-month deposit interest rate to 20.25 percent from 20.50 percent.
Liener said banks had gone short for the longer six-month and twelve-month periods ahead of the cuts and as they were now buying back this was keeping them away from the overnight market.
